parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · FVRD Electoral Area D · Popkum
Popkum is an unincorporated community in the Fraser Valley Regional District (FVRD) Electoral Area D, east of the City of Chilliwack.

The FVRD’s Electoral Area D Housing Needs Report (March 2021) describes Area D, which includes Popkum and Bridal Falls, as bounded by the Fraser River to the northwest, Electoral Area B to the north and east, Electoral Area E to the south and the City of Chilliwack to the west. It describes Popkum as a suburban residential neighbourhood closely affiliated with Chilliwack.

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.

Popkum-Bridal Falls (Area D) Official Community Plan, FVRD Bylaw No. 1501: a public hearing was held on December 15, 2020, and the FVRD’s First Quarter Update 2021 says the Board adopted it in January 2021.
Popkum is in an FVRD electoral area, Area D, which the FVRD report places outside the City of Chilliwack. The FVRD, not the City, sets its plan and zoning.
The FVRD’s report says the plan’s secondary dwellings policy (Policy 4.2.3) has the Regional Board support and encourage consideration of secondary dwellings for new neighbourhood developments.
ALR: ALR status is parcel-specific, so check the exact parcel on the Agricultural Land Commission map. Published municipal records do not list a separate ALR share or boundary for Popkum.

Flood: the FVRD report says Area D is bounded by the Fraser River to the northwest. Published municipal records do not list a separate flood or slope hazard statement for Popkum properties, so check site-specific hazard mapping with the FVRD before building or buying. Flood and hazard status is property-specific, so check the address with the FVRD.
Transit: BC Transit route 71 runs along Yale Road through Rosedale and the Popkum corridor. No other BC Transit route serving Popkum.
Popkum is outside the City of Chilliwack, so City zoning does not apply. The FVRD sets zoning for Electoral Area D. Send me the address and I’ll point you to the right FVRD rules.

Where is Popkum?
Popkum is an unincorporated community in FVRD Electoral Area D, east of the City of Chilliwack.

Area D is bounded by the Fraser River to the northwest, Electoral Area B to the north and east, Electoral Area E to the south and the City of Chilliwack to the west, and covers 233 square kilometres with 1,529 people in the 2016 Census.
Ask me if a specific address is in it.
How do I get around from Popkum?

BC Transit route 71 Agassiz–Harrison runs along Yale Road through Rosedale and the Popkum corridor. Its listed timing points include Yale Rd at McGrath Rd in Rosedale and Yale Rd at Hwy 9, and BC Transit’s Rider’s Guide map labels Popkum along the route.
No other BC Transit route serving Popkum.

route 71 page
Which school is near Popkum?
Rosedale Traditional Community School (kindergarten to grade 8), at 50850 Yale Rd, is the SD33 school on the Rosedale and Popkum side of the district. No school is in Popkum itself.
To find the secondary school for an exact address, use the
SD33 School Locator
What parks and library are near Popkum?
Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park (53480 Elgey Road) is a 107-hectare FVRD park with a floating boardwalk and no pets allowed.
Bridal Veil Falls Provincial Park is 16 km east of Chilliwack, off Exit 135.
There is no library branch in Popkum. The nearest are Chilliwack Library (45860 First Avenue) and Agassiz Library (7140 Cheam Avenue).
What plan covers Popkum?
The Popkum-Bridal Falls (Area D) Official Community Plan, FVRD Bylaw No. 1501, adopted by the FVRD Board in January 2021.
Is Popkum in a floodplain?
Published municipal records do not list a separate flood or slope hazard statement for Popkum properties. The FVRD report says Area D is bounded by the Fraser River to the northwest.
Flood and hazard status is property-specific, so ask me or the FVRD about a specific lot.

ALR status is set parcel by parcel, so check the exact address on the
Agricultural Land Commission map
